A '''Megafreighter''' was a type of [[Transport/Legends|transport]] vessel designed in the shape of a ring, similar to the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]]. By the [[Swarm War]], this model was considered ancient.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==History==
During the final stages of the Swarm War, the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] fleet used dozens of megafreighters.
The ships served as staging grounds for [[dartship]]s and were positioned around the edge of the space battle.<ref name="DNIII" />
